Name: Joja Prize Machine and Ticket Rebrand
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
It was only a matter of time before Joja found another perfectly innocent town feature to “improve.”

Gives the prize machine, prize machine menu interface, and prize ticket item a Joja themed visual makeover.

[b]There is a default "Any Route" version, and a separate "Joja Member Only" version. Please only install one version at a time.[/b]

Requirement:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[b]This mod only affects:[/b]
-Prize Machine asset in the Mayor's house
-Prize Machine interface
-Prize Ticket item
-It does not change any mechanics, rewards, or gameplay.

[b]There are two versions available:[/b]
-Members Only Version
This version only applies if the save file has a Joja membership. Perfect if you want the rebrand to feel like Joja officially took over the machine after you signed your soul away.

-Any Route Version
This version works for any save file, including players who did not choose the Joja route. Use this version if you want the Joja look without needing a Joja membership.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
-This mod is compatible with recolor mods and is set to load after them so the Joja Prize Machine, interface, and Prize Ticket take priority.
-It only replaces those 3 assets and does not affect any other interiors or recolor assets.
-If you use an interior recolor, such as DaisyNiko’s Earthy Interiors, the small wallpaper area behind the Prize Machine’s animated light bulb may not perfectly match. This is the only area that may look slightly mismatched.

[b]Install only one version at a time:[/b]
-Use the Joja Only version if you want the rebrand to appear only after getting a Joja membership.
-Use the Any Route version if you want the rebrand to appear on any save.

[b]Troubleshooting:[/b]
-The Joja Member Only version checks for the Joja membership flag on your save file, and only loads if you are a member.
-If the mod is not showing up, that save likely does not have the Joja membership flag. This usually means the save was completed through the Community Center route, not the Joja route.
-If you want the recolor to appear on any save, use the Any Route version instead.
-Please install only one version at a time.
